fixed.problem: Review blocking 1 (L3-run-11, half fixed). Every session-end commit in a folder project's git history still had this body: 'Session 01a1df1c-82d0-…, 2026-11-15T12:09:15.298Z. fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/loop-docs.test.ts, describe 'l3-small, run L3: the session-end commit in the folder names the session by its start (L3-run-11)'. Both cases failed at ed6e821. Case 1 runs a session through the runner in a folder project: the exact body expected, and no UUID or ISO instant anywhere in `git log --format=%B`. Case 2 is a session whose start is not known: it reads 'a session'.
fixed.how: Root cause: ProjectDocs.statusInFolder (packages/runtime/src/loop/docs.ts) put session.id and update.endedAt in the commit body. It now uses sessionWords(session.started_at ?? session.created_at), as the status file and the status pull request do. The body is 'Committed by Forerunner at the end of the session started 2026-11-15 14:00 UTC.', or '… of a session.' when the start is not known. The commit keeps its own date. Siblings checked: the snapshot, set-aside and failed-run commits (no id since ed6e821), the work-in-progress message (title only) and intake.ts's doc-set commit (no id). Docs: runtime.md (statusInFolder), user guide (Files).

All failed at ed6e821 (each seen failing before its fix):
- apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts, describe 'l3-small, run L3': 'the task drawer's Review list names what was found for a finding with no fix, never the placeholder; a fix the critic named stays (L3-research-3)' (GET /tasks/:id through the UI client) and 'a card that lists the critic's findings shows a finding with no fix by what was found alone (L3-research-3)' (GET /inbox details).

- apps/ui/test/mobile-reviews.test.tsx, describe 'l3-small, run L3: the phone's Reviews shows no empty 'Needed:' line (L3-research-3)'.
fixed.how:
Root cause: taskDetail (daemon/task-display.ts) and the chat's project facts (conversation/project-facts.ts) read `required_action || description`, and request-words' plainFinding kept the step's action. None of them told the critic's NO_ACTION_GIVEN filler apart from a fix it named.

Fix, in daemon/task-words.ts:
- New findingAsk(f) returns the named fix, or the finding's description when the critic named none. The drawer and the chat facts use it.
- New withoutNoActionGiven(step) drops a trailing ' -> <placeholder>' or ': <placeholder>' when a card's details are read. A card filed before this reads the same after an update.

Other changes:
- ReviewsScreen.tsx hides an empty 'Needed:' line, as ReviewsTab does with 'To fix'.
- task-words keeps the words as NO_FIX_NAMED rather than importing @forerunner/critic. Importing it put node:sqlite into the UI's jsdom bundle (mobile-home.test.tsx stopped loading). A runtime test pins NO_FIX_NAMED equal to NO_ACTION_GIVEN.
- The retry brief still gets the placeholder.

Docs: critic.md, runtime.md (drawer, chat context), apps.md (phone Reviews), user guide (Reviews).

notes_for_other_areas:
@forerunner/runtime daemon/task-words.ts (re-exported by task-display.ts) now exports:
- findingAsk(f: {required_action, description}): the fix the critic named, or the finding's description when it named none (empty, or NO_ACTION_GIVEN).
- withoutNoActionGiven(step): a card step without a trailing ' -> <placeholder>' or ': <placeholder>'.
- NO_FIX_NAMED: the critic's NO_ACTION_GIVEN words, kept here because the UI's tests read task-words and must not bundle @forerunner/critic (node:sqlite). conversation-memory.test.ts pins it equal.
Any new person-facing line built from a finding should use findingAsk.

taskDetail's review.open (GET /tasks/:id) and the chat's '# Tasks' 'still asked for: …' now name what was found when the critic named no fix. request-words' plainFinding (the details of retry, sign-off, blocked-findings and review-failed cards) drops the placeholder at read time. A card filed earlier reads the same.

specialistReason (daemon/request-words.ts) capitalises the first word only where a findings tag was taken off, and never a word that was in code marks. A reason with no tag keeps its own case. Areas asserting quoted reasons: 'git push was refused' now stays lower case.

ProjectDocs.statusInFolder's commit body is now 'Committed by Forerunner at the end of the session started <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM> UTC.' ('… of a session.' when the start is not known). The subject is unchanged ('Did "<task>", …' / 'Work of the session').
apps/ui ReviewsScreen (phone) renders 'Needed:' only when requiredAction is non-empty.

Suggested UPDATE-LOG/CHANGELOG lines for the session lead: 'In a project's folder, the commit Forerunner makes at the end of a session names the session by when it started ("Committed by Forerunner at the end of the session started 2026-11-15 14:00 UTC."), never its id (L3-run-11).' 'A finding the critic named no fix for reads as what it found in the task drawer, on the Inbox cards and in the chat; the phone's Reviews shows no empty "Needed:" line (L3-research-3).' 'A quoted reason that starts with a command keeps its case ("npm test fails") (L3-research-3).'
